title: Twitter Cyclone 3rd ET electronic road bike
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page for CYCLONE-3rd (ET) with WheelTop EDS TX 2×12. It publishes six-size geometry, high-modulus carbon frame and fork, threaded T47×24, RS alloy-wheel and 700×28C tire specifications, a 420×90 mm integrated carbon cockpit, 9.2 kg net weight, a US$1,489 made-to-order route and exact official gallery images. It does not publish maximum tire clearance, frame-only weight or a measured stiffness protocol.
